name: Giving Advice
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on giving advice — practice these key phrases out loud:
If I were you, I'd talk to them directly.
Have you thought about trying a different approach?
It might be worth giving it a little more time.
You should probably get a second opinion.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
